source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
3. Recognize problems in the system (including broken doors, missing extinguishers, etc.).
4. Confirm the source of any existing fire-safety data violations (i.e. broken sprinkler system, no exit signs, etc.).
5. Document any findings related to the fire-safety compliance of the property.
6. Document the cause of any failure or non-compliance with the code.
7. Provide a written statement of the violations found.
8. Suggest a remedy that is specific to the area of non-compliance.
9. Determine if the solution requires any special procedures or if the remedy is temporary.
10. Determine the best way to deal with the situation, if a solution is possible.
11. Include brief descriptions of suggested remedies in your written statement.
12. Record your findings in the building's Fire-Safety Compliance Report (Fire Safety Compliance Report).
13. Provide a copy
